insights: Qwen slashed prices on its Qwen3 30B A3B Instruct 2507 by 42% to $0.096 per million tokens, deepening its value play in the mid-tier segment. DeepSeek went the other direction, hiking its V4 Flash by 51% to $0.187, making the current best-value model in the reference list slightly more expensive. Qwen also introduced two new models without published intelligence scores: the Qwen2.5 72B Instruct at $0.373 and the Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct at $0.773, while removing the previous versions of those same names from the market. On the speed front, NVIDIA’s Nemotron 3 Super jumped 63% to 249 tokens per second, while Llama 3.2 11B Vision slowed 38% to 8 t/s. Arena-text data was unavailable today, so some quality comparisons may be incomplete.
